description: This file contains JavaScript code for CKEditor plugin 'pastetools' specifically for filtering and processing pasted images, including handling image sources, extracting images from RTF, and converting image URLs.

methods.name: u
methods.description: Replaces image src URLs in pasted content with corresponding data URLs or handles unsupported images.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Converts blob URLs to base64 data URLs and updates image src attributes.

methods.name: l
methods.description: Extracts image information from RTF data, including image types and identifiers.

methods.name: q
methods.description: Extracts image src URLs from HTML content.

methods.name: t
methods.description: Determines the image type from recognized image signatures.

methods.name: h
methods.description: Creates a data URL from image type and binary data.

methods.name: m
methods.description: Loads a blob URL and converts it to a base64 data URL.

methods.name: r
methods.description: Identifies image type from binary signature bytes.
